characters.name: Luna
characters.hair: long dark hair tied in a ponytail
characters.notes: Never wears a red bandana (the bandana is Alex’s only); permanent design since Episode 2 v3, Vio 2026-11-24

timeline: Day 47: the city fell in one night
Alex alone on the rooftop at sunset with the glowing baton; helicopter overhead
Max warns: the horde found the bridge
The horde is seen moving through the ruined city and across rooftops
Radio mentions a safe zone; Alex plans to move at dawn, Max says dawn is too late
Rooftop chase; Alex and Max jump the gap between buildings
Max slips at the rooftop edge; Alex pulls him up as the baton flares
The bunker door is locked; the radio crackles with a strange signal
The bunker door opens by itself; glowing eyes in the dark; a voice says 'You shouldn't be here.'
Episode 2: Shadow steps out of the bunker dark and knows Alex's name
Max wants to run; Alex refuses to leave until Shadow talks
Shadow reveals the safe zone is a lie; Alex asks who sent the signal
Luna appears and bandages Max's bleeding arm; she heard the radio too
Inside the bunker: Shadow has lived here since Day One; someone had to keep the door locked
The horde followed the baton light; the steel door rattles and won't hold
Escape plan: a tunnel under the floor; they go together
Radio orders Shadow: 'Shadow... the trap is set. Bring them to the safe zone.'
locations: Bunker interior - concrete room, supply shelves, pinned wall map, radio equipment
Floor hatch + tunnel ladder descending into the dark
important_events: Alex introduced on the rooftop, Day 47
Max warns the horde found the bridge
Radio safe-zone message heard; dawn departure planned and disputed
Max rescued at the rooftop edge
Locked bunker door; strange radio signal
Bunker door opens by itself; Shadow teased (glowing eyes + voice)
Shadow properly introduced; knows Alex's name
Safe zone revealed as a lie / lure
Luna's first appearance; treats Max's arm
Bunker interior revealed; Shadow lives there since Day One
Horde follows the baton light to the bunker
Tunnel escape; radio orders Shadow to bring them to the safe zone
unresolved_mysteries: Who is the voice on the radio giving Shadow orders — and what is the trap?
Is Shadow a friend, a prisoner of the voice, or the trap itself?
What is down the tunnel — and where does it lead?
Where is the safe zone, and is it real? (Known: the safe-zone message is a lie / lure.)
What happened on the night the city fell?
Are there other survivors besides Luna — and who else heard the radio?
relationships: Alex and Max: survival partners - Alex leads and plans, Max defends and warns; Alex saves Max at the rooftop edge
Shadow and the group: uneasy ally — told the truth about the safe zone but takes orders from the radio voice
Luna and the group: new ally — treats Max without being asked and joins the escape
Luna and Shadow: strangers who both found the bunker through the radio signal
